name: Yume No Office
source:
In this story, you play as a young man who loses his job and gets a new opportunity thanks to his childhood friend, Kaori.

Everything seems normal.
A new job, new routines... and five coworkers to spend your time with.

But as the days go by, things begin to pile up.
Relationships grow.
Meetings become more frequent.
And little by little... something starts to feel wrong.
